name: animate-pls
description: Animated videos made in code, on your own machine: explainers, product films, reels and edits of your own screen recordings, in 20 one-word designs (cutout, clay, comic, chalkboard, linocut, watercolor, terminal, poster and more), with word-by-word captions and an optional free local voice-over cloned from your own recording. MP4 in 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9.

interface.shortDescription: Animated videos made in code, narrated in your own voice
interface.longDescription: Describe a video and your agent writes it as one deterministic canvas page, then renders it to MP4 with a local browser and ffmpeg. Explainers, histories, product films, reels with word-by-word captions, and polished edits of your own screen recordings. Eleven styles or a new one from your references. The voice-over runs locally (VoxCPM2, cloned from your own recording); no AI video model and no subscription.
defaultPrompt: Use $animate-pls to make a 30-second explainer of how this repo works, crosshatch, 1:1
Use $animate-pls to turn my screen recording into a 9:16 product reel with captions
Use $animate-pls to make a 20-second kinetic-type reel of our launch announcement
